why: Issue #915. `act` claims a pad action when no panel is active, so the register's two `no active panel` entries -- Launch and a live match -- stand on a refusal that no longer happens. One mutation for both, because the refusal is the one line both share: with no panel displayed, `activePanelContainer` returns null at either surface. Killed by the two `leaves ... on purpose` cases, which assert the pad Down is refused rather than silently consumed.
killedBy: every HUD surface hands the pad a panel, or says why it does not (issue #914) leaves launch without an active panel on purpose -- the splash: the panel, topbar and touch row are all hidden behind it
every HUD surface hands the pad a panel, or says why it does not (issue #914) leaves playing without an active panel on purpose -- a live match: the arrows and the stick drive the tank, not a menu
